title: Augusta Triumphans Or, the Way to Make London the Most Flourishing City in the Universe
summary: "Augusta Triumphans" by Daniel Defoe is a pamphlet published in 1728. It also calls for measures against moral corruption and street crime, including better lighting and professional watchmen.
